english:
Standing in an Empowering Rift you create grants you <void Devour /> for 11 seconds. Exiting and re-entering the Rift refreshes the duration of <void Devour /> without needing a kill.

Kills with <void Devour /> active grant you 10% Class Ability Energy. Its duration can be refreshed to 11 seconds.

#ChunkEnergyScalars

source.text:
Standing on Empowering Rifts created by the user grants Devour for 11 seconds. 
Exiting, and then re-entering the same Empowering Rift refreshes the duration of Devour.
Secant Filaments' Devour can be refreshed to 11 seconds.

While Devour is active:
Kills grant 10% Class Ability Energy.
